verdict.rationale: Inngest exposes a REST API for events, function runs, and environments (inngest-docs-7, confirmed live but auth-gated in inngest-probe-rt-4), plus a CLI and MCP server that can inspect runs, fetch traces, and invoke functions (inngest-docs-8, inngest-docs-5, inngest-probe-rt-2/3). This covers core operational tasks but there's no discoverable OpenAPI spec (inngest-probe-3 shows 404s) and no explicit claim of full UI/API parity (e.g., environment/team management, billing, replay UI features aren't confirmed accessible via API). Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec, explicit documentation stating full UI feature parity, and evidence covering non-run-related UI functions (settings, billing, team management) via API.
